# Professional Services Rate Card

Approved by the Commercial Director, effective 1 January 2026, review due
31 December 2026.

Lead Penetration Tester: 4,800 AED per day.
Senior Penetration Tester: 3,900 AED per day.
Security Analyst: 2,700 AED per day.
Project Manager: 3,200 AED per day.

Rates are quoted for engagements delivered in the United Arab Emirates and
